item.title: Trump sues IRS for $10 billion
item.description: President Donald Trump sued the IRS on Thursday for a whopping $10 billion, according to a new report. The lawsuit claims the agency failed to prevent the president's tax returns from being leaked during his first administration, NBC News reported. The lawsuit, which was filed in Miami, also claims that Trump is suing the agency in his personal capacity, and not as President of the United States, according to the report.
